## Selected work

### Cable Manager (thesis project, 2026)

Case study: https://nathzramirez0-sys.github.io/My-Portfolio/projects/cable-manager.html
Role: Full-stack developer, in a thesis team of five. Source code is not public (built for a real client); walkthroughs on request.
Status: in use at the provider's office since October 2026, with over 900 subscribers.

Billing and subscriber management for a local cable and internet provider. One set of records, reached three ways:

- Office system: a single Windows installer (Inno Setup) that bundles Apache 2.4, MariaDB 10.4 and PHP 8.2. Runs on one office computer with no internet connection and nothing else installed.
- Subscriber portal: an installable web app where subscribers see bills, report payments and follow their requests to the office.
- Android app: native Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. Reminders, QR payment, payment history with a PDF statement, PDF receipts, connection tests. Keeps the last answer it was given, so it still shows a balance when the office computer is off.
- Remote access: Tailscale Funnel gives the portal and app a permanent HTTPS address with no router configuration.

Notable engineering:

- Atomic restore: takes a safety copy, refills tables inside one transaction, and refuses wrong, truncated or newer backups before touching anything. Automatic backup on every start, thirty kept.
- Sign-in throttling per account and per address on all three entry points, with doubling lockouts up to 30 minutes and an audit trail.
- Four roles (administrator, bookkeeper, staff, subscriber) enforced server-side. Prepared statements, CSRF tokens, bcrypt, hashed and expiring app tokens.
- Payment locking: a payment locks its bill inside the transaction (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE), so two staff can't record the same bill twice; a test reproduces the race.
- 1,157 automated tests in 17 files with no dependencies; each run rebuilds a throwaway database.
- October 2026: the office system and portal were redrawn in the Android app's design, and the app's text contrast was measured and fixed.
- November 2026, after going live: a reconnection fee, prorated first bills, bills staff can correct, advance credit that pays each new bill, a disconnection list and daily collections; official receipt (OR) numbers and receivables aging by area; job orders that send technicians out and take their materials from stock; payment reversals that change nothing until approved; outage and maintenance notices by area; password reset by a texted or emailed code; a Help Center for subscribers; and each subscriber texted their bill when the month's bills are made, queued and sent in the background.

## More projects

Solo: built alone, as full-stack developer. Team: a group project, as programmer.

- FergBentables (capstone project with a team of four; I designed and built the app; Android tablet app, 2026; case study: https://nathzramirez0-sys.github.io/My-Portfolio/projects/fergbentables.html): offline showroom counter app, in use at a showroom. Buyers, orders of up to 30 products followed from processing to delivery, every payment towards an order (downpayments included) with a PDF order slip showing the balance or a paid receipt, an Inventory System (stock that moves with each order, movement history, restock and low-stock reminders), Excel exports (Apache POI), encrypted backups (AES-256-GCM, key from the password by PBKDF2) whose restore checks the file before changing anything and rolls back on failure, and an optional PIN lock. Version 1.3.0. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room with tested migrations, WorkManager; 129 unit tests and 121 on-device tests. https://github.com/nathzramirez0-sys/fergbentables
- ThesisFlow (solo, Android app, 2026; case study: https://nathzramirez0-sys.github.io/My-Portfolio/projects/thesisflow.html; try the local build: https://nathzramirez0-sys.github.io/My-Portfolio/downloads/ThesisFlow-Local-0.1.0.apk): thesis and group-project manager for college students. Chapters with versioned drafts, adviser feedback, tasks with a kanban board, a group activity feed, push notifications, daily deadline reminders, a defense countdown and team stats, working offline. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, WorkManager, Vico, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions in TypeScript, Cloud Messaging, per-role security rules). Two builds from one codebase: the cloud build on Firebase, and a local build that keeps everything in Room on one phone with no account or internet, where a people list stands in for sign-in and a sample group shows every role. 142 unit tests, 59 security-rule tests on the Firebase emulators, 26 on-device tests for the local build, Room migration tests, GitHub Actions CI. https://github.com/nathzramirez0-sys/ThesisFlow

PHP, MySQL, JavaScript.
- Auction Market (solo, web, 2026): sellers list items, buyers bid, the current bid updates without reloading, admin analytics. PHP, MySQL, JavaScript.
